territory: Synthetic data for vision/ML: generative or simulated training data, sim-to-real, synthetic-data curricula, contamination-safe eval sets, data-quality vs quantity trade-offs. Academic ML only.
schema_notes: Each JSONL line carries the parent-mandated fields (candidate_id, territory, title, one_line_idea, cluster, problem, core_hypothesis, falsifiable_prediction, why_important, why_possibly_novel, minimal_falsification_experiment, main_risk, community_default_belief, why_it_might_be_wrong, fastest_falsifying_experiment, evidence_label) plus the shard_format aliases (core_claim, method_sketch, novelty_hook, kill_risk) mirroring their counterparts, consistent with sibling shards genA-01..06. Every candidate states the community default belief, why it might be wrong, and a cheapest falsifying experiment.

compliance.scope: All 100 candidates are ordinary academic computer-vision/ML research on synthetic training data, sim-to-real transfer, curricula, contamination-safe evaluation, and quality-quantity trade-offs; no security, intrusion, or reverse-engineering content.
compliance.forbid_fiction: No fabricated papers, citations, benchmark numbers, dataset facts, or claimed experimental results; all quantitative statements are phrased as falsifiable predictions under HYPOTHESIS or MODEL SPECULATION labels.
compliance.novelty_claims: All novelty statements are hedged as possibly-novel and explicitly marked unverified; no verified novelty claimed.
compliance.protected_files: window.lock.json, research_state.json, ideas_master.jsonl untouched; no Windows directories created; no Windows numbers changed; only the two listed output files written under Windows16/_state/tasks/P1/.

unresolved_items: Novelty of all 100 candidates is unverified against the literature; Wave B dedup plus any novelty-checking stage must vet before promotion.
